videos.title: Female Homepage Hero
videos.summary: Best suited for the homepage hero, first-time welcome, and warm onboarding flow.
cue_points: Use this for the strongest first impression on the homepage.
Pair it with onboarding and the welcome flow.
videos.transcript_hint: Keep the tone welcoming, premium, calm, and aspirational.

videos.title: Welcome Back
videos.summary: Best suited for return users, login reinforcement, and a personalized welcome-back experience.
cue_points: Use this after sign-in or when the learner returns after a break.
Can introduce the latest progress summary or next step.
videos.transcript_hint: Keep it personal and supportive, as if greeting a returning learner by name.

videos.title: Strategy Focus
videos.summary: Best suited for tips, last-minute revision, and exam strategy guidance.
cue_points: Use this when the student needs sharper exam tactics.
It fits the Tips and Last Minute experience very well.
videos.transcript_hint: Keep the message crisp, high-energy, and strategy-driven.

videos.title: Problem Solving
videos.summary: Best suited for Tutor mode, worked examples, and the 3D concept bridge for physics or math.
cue_points: Use this to explain a concept in a stepwise way.
It should feed the 3D concept board and reasoning panel.
videos.transcript_hint: Use a clear teach-then-check structure and end with a simple practice prompt.
